name: MLP SE
summary: MLP SE, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Germany. The company operates through Financial Consulting, Banking, FERI, DOMCURA, Industrial Broker, and Deutschland. It operates through Financial Consulting, Banking, FERI, DOMCURA, Industrial Broker, and Deutschland.Immobilien segments. The Financial Consulting segment offers consulting services for academics and other clients related to insurance, investments, and occupational pension provision schemes; and health and non-life insurance, real estate brokerage, wealth management, and loans and mortgages, as well as the brokering of contracts in financial services.
